study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative trajectories of R 1 , R 2 *, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The introduction explicitly states three aims: delineating normative trajectories with Gaussian Process Regression and volumetric analysis, examining independence of deviations across metrics and across nuclei, and testing the utility of trajectories in a validation dataset including Parkinson's disease. These objectives also clarify why normative modeling is applied.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "Our objectives were threefold: (1) to delineate normative trajectories across subcortical grey matter nuclei throughout the lifespan using a Gaussian Process Regression model along with conventional volumetric analysis; (2) to investigate the independence of deviations from normative values within each subcortical nucleus...; and (3) to examine the independence of variations from normative values across the subcortical nuclei... Lastly, we tested the utility of the normative trajectories in a validation dataset consisting of both healthy participants and people with Parkinson's disease."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: For the newly built normative model, the ABRIM cohort inclusion/exclusion and imaging quality criteria are detailed (whole-brain coverage, brain extraction, motion artifacts), with QC by three raters. They report exclusions (41 removed) and final sample size of 260 participants with age range and mean.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Visual data curation was performed... Three raters... assessed the quality of all datasets. The following criteria were used to exclude data from further analysis: - Does the imaging volume cover the whole brain...? - Does brain extraction apply correctly? - Any visible motion artefacts...? Forty-one participants were excluded... resulting in data of 260 participants to be included in the statistical analysis (18-79 years; mean ± standard deviation (SD) = 50.8 ± 16.8 years...)."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Covariates age, age-squared, sex, and hemisphere were explicitly included in the GLM design matrix and corrections were applied before GPR modeling, addressing demographic and hemispheric/site-related effects.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "The design matrix comprised four regressors: Age, Age2, Sex, and (left-/right-) Hemisphere."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The ABRIM data source is identified as the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory collection with DOI provided, indicating provenance of the reference cohort used to build the new normative models.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Data utilised to derive the normative trajectories is part of the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory (ABRIM) data collection... available at https://doi.org/10.34973/7q0a-vj19."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: For the primary ABRIM data, the imaging modality and parameters are specified, including MP2RAGE T1, B1 mapping, and multi-echo GRE with TR/TE, flip angles, resolution, and acquisition times on a 3T Siemens scanner.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "The imaging protocol... consisted of 1. Whole-brain T1 (=1/R1) scan using MP2RAGE... TR/TE = 6000 ms/2.34 ms, resolution = 1 mm iso., acquisition time (TA) = 7 min; 2. Whole-brain turbo FLASH B1 mapping, TR/TE = 10000/2.23...; 3. Bipolar 3D multi-echo GRE, TR/TE1/ΔTE = 44 ms/6.14 ms/4 ms... resolution = 0.8 mm iso., TA = 9.5 min."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The preprocessing steps and tools are described: skull stripping with SynthStrip, QSM pipeline using SEPIA v1.2.2.4 including phase correction, ROMEO, V-SHARP, LP-CNN; MP-PCA denoising for R2*, and B1-corrected R1 mapping with specific scripts, indicating software and QC procedures.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "SynthStrip... was used for skull stripping... χ maps were derived using SEPIA v1.2.2.4... bipolar gradient phase correction... ROMEO... V-SHARP... LP-CNN... For R2* mapping, Marchenko-Pastur Principal Component Analysis (MP-PCA) denoising... was applied... Quantitative R1 maps were obtained using the BIDS-compatible Matlab function 'bids_T1B1correct.m'... used to (3) correct for the B1 transmit inhomogeneities..."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: They performed 10-fold cross-validation within the ABRIM cohort when computing the Gaussian Process Regression normative trajectories, satisfying the requirement for partitioned internal validation.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "Gaussian Process Regression (GRP)... from PCNToolkit... was used to compute the normative trajectory... with 10-fold cross-validation."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The ABRIM-derived normative models were applied to an independent PPP cohort of healthy volunteers and Parkinson's patients, assessing alignment of data points and z-score distributions, indicating external validation on an independent dataset not used for model development.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "To study the applicability of the R2* and χ normative models derived from the ABRIM datasets, an independent cohort... part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP)... was used." / "Validation of the normative models derived from the ABRIM data was performed by applying the normative models to the PPP cohort... The median z-scores were close to zero for almost all subcortical nuclei, and the z-score distributions of the PPP healthy controls fell within the range of |z| ≤ 1.96 (~95% CI)..."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical modeling approach is detailed: GLM with age, age², sex, and hemisphere covariates followed by Gaussian Process Regression implemented with PCNToolkit to derive normative trajectories and z-scores, using 10-fold cross-validation, indicating model type, settings, and software.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "General Linear Model (GLM)... design matrix comprised four regressors: Age, Age2, Sex, and (left-/right-) Hemisphere... Gaussian Process Regression (GRP)... from PCNToolkit... was used to compute the normative trajectory... with 10-fold cross-validation. While GRP also provides the z-statistics as a major output..."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Although cross-validation was performed and trajectories visualized, the paper does not report quantitative performance metrics (e.g., prediction error, variance explained, calibration) for the normative models on the reference cohort.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The methods describe modelling and cross-validation but provide no quantitative fit metrics; Figure descriptions focus on trajectories and confidence intervals without reporting errors or variance explained.

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: While 10-fold cross-validation was used, the manuscript does not report sample sizes or demographic characteristics for each fold/partition of the reference cohort.
nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.supporting_text: "Gaussian Process Regression... was used... with 10-fold cross-validation." (No accompanying description of partition sizes or demographics.)

nm11_reproducibility.reason: Software versions and tools are noted (SEPIA v1.2.2.4; specific scripts for R1 mapping), and both datasets plus processing pipeline scripts are made available with DOIs and repository links, indicating code/data accessibility to reproduce analyses.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: "χ maps were derived using SEPIA v1.2.2.4..." / "Quantitative R1 maps were obtained using... 'bids_T1B1correct.m'... 'MP2RAGE_dictionaryMatching.m.'" / "The ABRIM dataset and processing pipeline scripts... are available at https://doi.org/10.34973/atyn-r066. The processing pipeline scripts associated with the PPP dataset are available on the same repository..."

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: For the PPP clinical cohort, they describe patient eligibility (within 5 years of Parkinson's diagnosis), visual QC criteria applied, handling of repeat scans, and report final included numbers (316 patients, 44 controls).
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: "The PPP study followed 520 patients who were diagnosed with Parkinson's disease for 2 years... The same visual data curation process used for the ABRIM dataset was applied... only the first scan was included... If the first scan did not meet the inclusion criteria, the second scan was included... In this analysis, data from 44 healthy volunteers and 316 patients were used."

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: Analyses compare deviation z-scores and qMRI values between patients and controls without incorporating clinical covariates such as medication status, illness duration, or symptom severity; only demographic/hemisphere corrections are mentioned.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: "Both R2* and χ in the PPP dataset were first corrected for the sex and hemispheric differences... Two-sample t-tests were also performed to compare the z-scores and the median qMRI values... between the healthy controls and Parkinson's disease patients."

cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.reason: The clinical imaging data are sourced from the Personalized Parkinson Project (PPP), identified by name and prior publication, with description of the cohort scope and imaging site/protocol.
cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: "an independent cohort with a similar imaging protocol, which is part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP) data collection (Bloem et al., 2019)... During the study, two MRI scans were made for each participant... Data acquisition was performed at 3T (Siemens, Erlangen, Germany)."

cr4_clinical_characteristics_clinical_co.reason: Table 2 reports sample sizes and age distributions for controls and patients, including male/female counts and mean ± SD ages.

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.reason: The manuscript does not describe clinical assessment tools or procedures (e.g., symptom scales); it only notes that full clinical characteristics are reported elsewhere without specifying measures.
cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: "were within 5 years of diagnosis and full clinical characteristics can be found in Johansson, Toni, et al. (2023) and Johansson, van Lier, et al. (2023)."

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: They report and interpret z-score distributions from the normative model, noting alignment of healthy controls within |z|≤1.96 (~95% CI) and higher z-scores in Parkinson's patients for specific nuclei, but do not fully explain clinical meaning of score direction or broader implications.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: "The median z-scores were close to zero for almost all subcortical nuclei, and the z-score distributions of the PPP healthy controls fell within the range of |z| ≤ 1.96 (~95% CI)... When examining Parkinson's disease patients... exceptions noted for SNc and SNr... Two-sample t-test results indicated that the z-scores of both R2* and χ in SNc were significantly higher in the Parkinson's disease patients..."
